model_notes: DiT (Diffusion Transformer), 56 blocks (8 dual-stream + 48 single-stream), hidden_dim=3072, 48 attention heads, attention_head_dim=128, joint_attention_dim=15360, BF16 precision. xDiT with Ulysses Sequence Parallelism degree=8. 4608 total tokens at 1024x1024 → 576 tokens/GPU after SP split.

xfuser/model_executor/models/transformer: Remove .to(query.dtype) after hidden_states.flatten(2,3) in both processors — aiter BF16 → BF16 by contract, cast is a no-op

do_not_set.XDIT_ATTENTION_BACKEND=aiter_fp8: CRASH / -7.0%: FP8 quant overhead >> compute savings at 576 tok/GPU. Attention is only ~2% of FLOPS.
do_not_set.XDIT_ATTENTION_BACKEND=aiter_sage_v2: -8.66%: same root cause; also MXFP4 quantization
do_not_set.RCCL_MSCCL_ENABLE=1 + NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS: -13.0%: RCCL native algorithm already optimal for 2.53MB per-pair A2A at 8 GPUs via XGMI
do_not_set.PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_TUNING=1: CRASH when combined with torch.compile — GPU memory fault (writes to read-only cudagraph memory)
do_not_set.torch.backends.cuda.preferred_blas_libra: CRASH — CK has no device_gemm for FLUX.2 GEMM shapes (M=576, non-standard N dims)
do_not_set.AMD_DIRECT_DISPATCH=1 + AMDGCN_USE_BUFFE: KNOWN CRASH: -28.6% — never combine these two
do_not_set.HIP_FORCE_DEV_KERNARG=1: -0.29%: cudagraphs already eliminate per-kernel CPU dispatch overhead; device arg placement adds overhead
do_not_set.coordinate_descent_tuning=True: 0% gain — AITER/hipBLASLt not Triton; norm/act ops too small fraction of runtime

what_worked.description: Bundle: torch.compile(reduce-overhead) + combine_qkv_a2a=True in dual-stream blocks + reshape fix
what_worked.note: FLUX.2-dev in xDiT had two bugs vs FLUX.1: missing combine_qkv_a2a=True in dual-stream attention processors, and wrong torch.compile mode (default instead of reduce-overhead). These fixes, plus a reshape optimization to avoid a contiguous copy in the combined QKV all-to-all, together give +3.44%. These are also correctness/code-quality improvements: .to(query.dtype) removal (aiter returns BF16 by contract), reshape vs view.
Within measurement noise (single-image benchmark, 3 timing samples). Expected +1.87% per KB but measured +0.29%. Kept because direction correct and no quality impact.

what_failed.description: All approximate attention backends (aiter_fp8, aiter_sage, aiter_sage_v2)
what_failed.root_cause: With 8-way Ulysses, each GPU handles only 6 attention heads and 576 tokens. Attention FLOPS = ~2% of total. Any quantization/approximation overhead exceeds compute savings.
what_failed.recommendation: Never optimize attention backends for FLUX.2 on Ulysses=8. Only beneficial at Ulysses≤2 where tokens/GPU are larger.

what_failed.root_cause: RCCL native algorithm is optimal for 2.53MB per-pair AllToAll at 8 GPUs. MSCCL adds routing overhead that exceeds savings. Async overlap (USP_deferred) causes torch.compile graph breaks at closure boundaries.
what_failed.recommendation: A2A communication is a hard floor. Only fused QKV projection at GEMM level would reduce A2A count further.

what_failed.root_cause: hipBLASLt already uses optimal kernel for M=576 BF16. CK crashes for non-standard N dims. TunableOp only searches hipBLASLt algorithm index (same search hipBLASLt already does) and crashes with torch.compile in TUNING=1 mode. Triton coordinate_descent tuning irrelevant since AITER/hipBLASLt handle 95%+ of compute.
what_failed.recommendation: M=576 BF16 GEMM is already at hardware ceiling. Only fused QKV (6 GEMMs→1 per dual-stream block) or hipBLASLt epilog fusions could give further gains.

architectural_insights.attention_fraction: ~2% of total FLOPS at 576 tok/GPU (Ulysses=8, 1024x1024, BF16)
architectural_insights.a2a_count_before_patch: 4 per dual-stream block (Q, K, V separate + output)
architectural_insights.a2a_count_after_patch: 2 per dual-stream block (combined QKV input + output)

next_session_recommendations: Fused QKV projection for dual-stream blocks: 6 separate linear layers (Q,K,V + enc_Q,enc_K,enc_V) → 1 combined GEMM. Requires modifying diffusers Flux2Attention. Estimated gain: 2-5%.
hipBLASLt epilog fusion for MLP branch GELU in single-stream blocks. Estimated gain: 1-3%.
torch.compile(mode='max-autotune') — exhaustive Triton autotune for norm/activation ops. Risky (may pick Triton GEMM over hipBLASLt for M=576). Estimated gain: 0-2%.
Partial TunableOp offline workflow: pre-collect shapes without torch.compile → tune → run with tuned CSV + torch.compile. Expected gain: ~0.28% (noise level).
Profile with torch.profiler to get accurate GEMM vs A2A vs norm breakdown. Current estimates are roofline-based.
